name: JoulWatt Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: JoulWatt Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, and sale of analog integrated circuits in China. It offers automotive rear and interior LED driver products; and power management products, such as switching DC/DC power supply, isolated switching DC/DC, power switch and protection, gate driver, power module, display power over ethernet, LDO, voltage supervisory, Vcore power, USB IC, DC input LED driver, and motor driver.
